title: Qatar GKG share jump leads LNG returns
hypothesis: R2 | [gas-lng] GDELT qatar GKG share day-over-day pct change > 50 pct leads Cheniere returns by 2 days (+); trade long LNG 5d [gdelt.gkg.qatar_share -> finance.LNG.log_return]
message: Supported but weak: r=0.12 (n=390), best lag -2d; rule z>1 long LNG 1d: 37 trades, hit 54%, excess +0.09%/trade pre-war but war-test (n=7) negative; actionability 4.34 - story not a rule

trade_idea.entry_rule: gdelt.gkg.qatar_share rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long LNG next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [gas-lng] GDELT Qatar GKG share 20d z-score > 1.5 marks peak attention that fades: LNG log return reverses over the next 3 days (-); trade short LNG 3d [gdelt.gkg.qatar_share -> finance.LNG.log_return] (parent: R2-0022)
